content.text:
The likely cause is **a full page reload before the dark styles arrive**.

Navigation uses ordinary links, and the app chooses its page when each new document loads. The black background and dark color scheme come from CSS imported by JavaScript; [index.html](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/index.html:3) has no initial background styling. See [App.svelte](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/App.svelte:5), [main.ts](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/main.ts:3), and [styles.css](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/styles.css:1).

The browser probe supports that explanation: clicking the search link requested a new document. Deliberately delaying its stylesheet produced a completely white screen; releasing it restored black. That demonstrates the mechanism, although it does not reproduce the precise timing in your browser.

I’d recommend putting a tiny inline black background and dark color scheme in the document’s `<head>`, so they apply immediately. This is a proposed fix, not a tested change.

Native navigation was intentional: [the design notes](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/docs/entity-details.md:94) say it preserves browser history, reload, and new-tab behavior without a router. No flash-specific rationale surfaced.
